inputs.lyrics:
[verse]
The gate is shut, the horn still rings
we run the drain where no light sings
her hand in mine, the crown held low
the river waits, it's time to go
[chorus]
hold the line, hold the crown
before the dawn comes burning down
one more mile, one more night
ride the dark into the light
